 1. Loose, Vikr. d. 115; Pañc. ii. d. 143; [] loosened,

. Flaccid, faded, Śāk. d. 41.
 3. Feeble, languid,

. Not very careful, Pañc. ii. d. 82.

शिथिल + ता, f.
 1. Looseness, state of dissolution, Pañc. 30, 11.
 2. Relaxedness, relaxation.
 3. Want of energy, Pañc. iv. d. 7.

शिथिलय, a denomin. derived from शिथिल, Par. To loosen, to make loose, Śāk. 9, 21.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शिथिलित (or शिथिल + इत).
 1. Loosened, loosed, loose, Śāk. d. 57.
